_comment: Copy this file to deploy.config.json (gitignored) and fill in your own values. deploy.ps1 reads it to know which existing deployment to redeploy to, so the live /exec URL never changes.
_deploymentId: The AKfyc... segment of your web app URL: https://script.google.com/macros/s/<deploymentId>/exec. Find it in the Apps Script editor under Deploy > Manage deployments.
_webAppUrl: Optional. Only used for the success message and -Open. Derived from deploymentId when omitted.
